note: 20 subtopics, above the usual 4-15, because the input lists 17 book headings and NEET can target each bacterial/protistan/fungal group separately. Gaps in the input: passage ids P27-P32 are absent, so there is no passage for the 2.3 KINGDOM FUNGI general introduction and none covering viroids, prions or lichens in any detail (only the 2.6 opening passage P40) - no subtopic was written for content that has no passage. P45 and P54 are identical EXERCISES passages and are kept together; they plus the SUMMARY passages P52/P53 are chapter-wide and were attached to the subtopics whose idea they open with (history of classification for P52, Monera for P53). Chapter front matter P01 (empty figure), P02 ("CHAPTER 2") and P07 (title and contents list) were attached to subtopic 1. Also noted: the contents list in P07 reads "2.6 Viruses, Viroids and Lichens" while the input heading 2.6 reads "VIRUSES, VIROIDS, PRIONS AND LICHENS". Figure placement for P35 is uncertain because the passages are not in book order; it was attached to the last fungal class (Deuteromycetes) that precedes 2.4 in the input.
